'''792.667/Z6''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] assigned to oversee [[Altratonne Station]]'s landing platform on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Altratonne]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="MBC" />
